datasets.title: GRMA CR-Agriculture Exposure Model
datasets.description: Agriculture exposure model for Costa Rica. Includes exposure data for Coffee, Sugarcane and Cattle
datasets.purpose: This dataset was created for multihazard risk assessment as part of the implementation of the GRMA program in Costa Rica
datasets.details: Agricultural exposure model for Costa Rica. It includes exposure data for coffee, sugarcane, and cattle. The locations correspond to the centroids of productive properties, which were used as the modelling land units. The model was developed from the most recent land-cover distribution, assigning production randomly to land units in order to match regional production totals.
